task.name: Release Notes Completeness Check
task.description: Review newly published release tags and surface only releases whose repository release notes omit at least one required operator-facing change category such as breaking changes, migration steps, or rollback guidance.
task.intent: Reduce operator time spent discovering incomplete release communication after shipping repository changes without reopening releases whose omissions are already tracked or explicitly accepted.
activationConditions: A new repository release or version tag is published within the evidence window in a covered repository.
Authoritative repository release evidence shows the published release notes omit at least one required operator-facing change category for the shipped changes.
requiredEffects: Each novel completeness finding identifies the release, the missing required change category, and the repository evidence supporting the omission.
Maintainers can accept, reject, or resolve each surfaced finding using repository-linked evidence.
noopConditions: Every newly published covered release already includes all required operator-facing change categories.
Every supported release-notes completeness finding for the covered releases is already tracked or explicitly accepted.
successConditions: Supported release-notes completeness findings receive accepted remediation evidence or an explicit maintainer dismissal within the evidence window.
Releases whose notes already satisfy the required change categories create no duplicate maintainer attention.
uncertainties: A release may intentionally delegate one required change category to a separately linked migration guide or rollback playbook.
One published release can omit more than one required change category and therefore produce more than one supported finding.

operationalValue.statement: The proportion of supported, novel release-notes completeness findings assigned to the run that are resolved or explicitly dismissed within 14 days.
operationalValue.opportunity: One workflow run and the deduplicated supported release-notes completeness findings it assigns for newly published covered releases.
acceptedEvidence: A merged pull request or edited repository release description that adds the missing breaking-change, migration, or rollback detail to the identified release notes before the evidence cutoff.
A closed tracking issue, release conversation, or pull request conversation that explicitly marks the finding resolved, dismissed, or accepted by a maintainer.
evidenceRepositories: The repository in which the workflow ran.

metric.name: resolved-supported-release-notes-findings
metric.formula: resolved-or-dismissed supported findings / supported novel findings assigned to the run

operationalValue.maturation: 14 days after the workflow run completes.
operationalValue.zeroRule: Return 0 when at least one supported novel release-notes completeness finding was assigned and none has accepted resolution evidence by the evidence cutoff.
operationalValue.missingRule: Return null when the assigned finding set or required repository release evidence for newly published covered releases cannot be read.
